notes.en: Target stats at level 60: ATK 2,600 to 3,400+ (Depending on W-Engine choice), HP 10,000+, DEF 800+, Anomaly Mastery 148 to 190+, Anomaly Proficiency 350 to 450+.
Partners Prydwen lists for this agent (each group is one entry in its synergy list): [[character:nangong-yu]]; [[character:yuzuha]], [[character:rina]], [[character:remielle]].

The W-Engine ranking was calculated with [[character:nangong-yu]] (Neon Fantasies) and [[character:yuzuha]] (Kaboom the Cannon) as teammates. Percentages are relative to the first-listed W-Engine at the refinement Prydwen marks as 100%.
